pageContent.packagesHeading: Exclusive Student Package for ISIC Cardholders
pageContent.packagesIntro: JVTO collaborates with ISIC to offer student-friendly pricing structures for safe, all-inclusive volcano tours. These prices are only available to ISIC cardholders. To redeem, you must have a valid ISIC card.
pageContent.whatIsIntroBefore: Opting for a student package does
pageContent.whatIsIntroAfter: mean cutting corners. It's designed for students travelling in small groups, offering a fairer pricing structure while maintaining our high standards.

features.title: Private Structure
features.desc: Strictly private tour structure. No mixed groups.

features.title: All-Inclusive
features.desc: Includes park fees, permits, and transport.

features.title: High Safety
features.desc: Same high safety standards, including health screening.

pageContent.needCardIntro: The International Student Identity Card (ISIC) is the only globally recognized proof of full-time student status. Get yours today to unlock thousands of benefits!
pageContent.howToApplyHeading: How to Apply the ISIC Code

steps.title: Choose Your Adventure
steps.text: Visit our website and select the volunteer or tour package you wish to book. Click on the "Book Now" button.

steps.title: Fill in Your Details
steps.text: Complete the booking form with your personal details. In the "Discount Code" field, enter your unique ISIC code.

steps.title: Apply & Verify
steps.text: Click "Apply". The discount will be calculated. Proceed with your booking. We may ask to verify your ISIC card upon arrival.
